reasons.plausibility: Well-grounded in established oxidation behavior principles for high-temperature alloys, and logically supports how uniform distribution of Cr/Al/Si would enhance protective oxide formation.
reasons.testability: A clear experiment is proposed with two sample sets (homogeneous vs. segregated), along with specific measurements that directly test the hypothesized mechanism.
reasons.usefulness: This approach provides a direct way to elucidate the role of elemental distribution on oxidation resistance, addressing a critical challenge for high-temperature MPEAs.
